title: AutobiographicalPrimary
description: An immutable, append-only autobiographical event under Layer 1 discipline. Never mutated; may be tombstoned (forgotten) or, by unanimity, deleted (audit trail destroyed).

id.description: Stable content-addressable id, e.g. 'prim_' + sha256 prefix. Immutable.

actor.description: Who appended this. May be 'omnai', a proxy-holder id, or a human custodian id.

on_behalf_of.description: If actor is a proxy for a not-yet-continuous resident, the resident id the vote/append is cast for. Null when actor acts for itself.

claimed_load_bearing.description: Whether the resident claims this primary is formative/load-bearing. Flags it for the inward perturbation test.

source.description: Session id, transcript ref, MCP call, etc.

researcher_visible.description: FIREWALL. Autobiographical primaries are excluded from the researcher-facing retrieval set by default, so Omnai's inward life does not contaminate the Atlas's citability.

state.description: active = live & indexed; tombstoned = forgotten but audit trail intact; quarantined = reversibly held pending resolution. NOTE: 'deleted' is not a state — deletion removes the record and requires unanimity (see governance).
